_comment: TEMPLATE for the Robinhood Chain mainnet launch via Pons (the internal docs repo). Every field is present; null = fill in after the launch / our PonsFeeVault deploy. The admin Token panel (Admin → Token) can override token, feeVault, creditPool, treasury, stable, swapRouter, priceFeed, deployBlock, excludeWallets without editing this file; what it saves lives in the gateway DB (chain_settings) and wins over these values. While token or feeVault is null the gateway stays on the mock adapter (`/health` → adapter: mock (waiting for token)).
_comment_rpcUrl: Public RPC for reads. For production set MESH_EVM_RPC_URL=https://robinhood-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/<KEY> (env, never commit the key). eth_getLogs chunking is logChunkBlocks.
_comment_feeSource: pons = creator fees accrue in the Pons Fee Escrow for our PonsFeeVault; no MeshToken transfer fee.
_comment_token: The $MESH ERC-20 the Pons factory minted. From the dev after launch (TokenLaunched event / Pons UI).
_comment_curve: Pons bonding-curve address for this token (holds the pre-graduation supply). From the dev. ALSO add it to excludeWallets.
_comment_poolId: Uniswap v4 pool id after graduation (PoolGraduated event). Informative; the v4 PoolManager holds the liquidity, add the PoolManager / locked-position holder to excludeWallets if balances show up there.
_comment_deployBlock: Block of the launch tx: Transfer scans start here. Set from the launch receipt.
_comment_pons: Pons v2 protocol contracts on Robinhood Chain mainnet (docs.ponsfamily.com/docs/v2). Verify on Blockscout before the first live sweep.
_comment_feeVault: Our PonsFeeVault (contracts/evm/src/PonsFeeVault.sol), deployed with contracts/evm/script/DeployPonsFeeVault.s.sol. This address is the Pons creatorFeeRecipient.
_comment_creditPool: Credit reserve: the holder share of every sweep lands here in the stable and stays apart from the treasury. Its balance is read every epoch and published next to credits outstanding (GET /report totals.reserve). Excluded from holder balances.
_comment_treasury: Treasury multisig: the treasury share of every sweep.
_comment_quoteTokens: Assets Pons pays creator fees in. 0x000…0 = native ETH; 0xd060…9EEC = NVDA (the launch pairs against NVDA, so creator fees arrive in NVDA and the vault swaps them to USDG).
_comment_stable: USDG on Robinhood Chain the vault settles in. Required before the first live sweep: with sweepMode swap and no stable the vault's sweep() reverts, the epoch is recorded as failed and the fees wait in the vault (nothing is lost, nothing is minted).
_comment_swapRouter: Uniswap v3 SwapRouter02 (or null and configure a RouteKind.Adapter on the vault for the v4 universal router). The route itself is set on the vault with setRoute(); this field is informative for the admin Check.
_comment_sweepMode: swap = PonsFeeVault.sweep() converts each fee asset to the stable through the vault's route, so the holder share reaches the credit pool in dollars and backs the USD credits it mints 1:1. raw = sweepRaw() forwards ETH and values it off-chain: the pool then carries the ETH price risk, so it is for the testnet rehearsal only (docs/PRICING.md, section 5).
_comment_priceFeed: Chainlink ETH/USD aggregator on Robinhood Chain. It sets the slippage floor of each swap. When it is stale (over an hour old) or unreadable the ETH fees are left unswept until it is fresh; fixedEthUsd (or MESH_FIXED_ETH_USD) is used only when no feed is configured at all.
_comment_excludeWallets: Pons protocol contracts are prefilled. ADD after launch: the bonding curve address, and after graduation the v4 PoolManager / locked LP position holder. feeVault, creditPool, treasury and the sweeper are excluded implicitly by the adapter.
